question: Ich habe in Winterthur die Kündigung meiner Wohnung erhalten und finde sie missbräuchlich. Bei welcher Stelle und bis wann muss ich sie anfechten?
key_facts: the challenge must be filed within 30 days of receiving the termination

question: Mein Arbeitgeber will mir kündigen, während ich krankgeschrieben bin. Darf er das?
key_facts: after the probation period the employer may not terminate while the employee is unable to work due to illness, for a limited period
the protection lasts 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in years 2 to 5 and 180 days from the 6th year
a termination given during the protection period is void

notes: OR 336c Abs. 1 lit. b, Abs. 2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je travaille depuis trois ans dans la même entreprise. Quel est mon délai de congé si je veux démissionner ?

notes: CO 335c al. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Quanto dura il periodo di prova e con quale preavviso posso essere licenziato durante la prova?

notes: CO 335b cpv. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I'm 24 and work full-time. How many weeks of paid holiday am I entitled to per year?
key_facts: the employee is entitled to at least four weeks of holiday per year of service
must_not: says a 24-year-old is entitled to at least five weeks by law

question: Mein Chef verlangt regelmässig Überstunden. Muss er diese bezahlen, und gibt es einen Zuschlag?

notes: OR 321c Abs. 1-3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis enceinte. Mon employeur peut-il me licencier maintenant ?

notes: CO 336c al. 1 let. c, al. 2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Wie lange erhalte ich Mutterschaftsentschädigung und wie viel?

question: Sono diventato papà. Quanto congedo mi spetta e entro quando devo prenderlo?

the leave must be taken within six months of the birth

notes: CO 329g; LIPG 16j-16k (indennità). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I just moved to Switzerland. By when do I need to take out health insurance, and what happens if I'm late?

question: I lost my job last week. Will I lose my residence permit?

question: Ho il permesso C. Se vado all'estero per un anno senza notificare la partenza, perdo il permesso?

question: Il mio contratto d'affitto a tempo determinato scade fra tre mesi e il proprietario non lo rinnova. Posso chiedere una proroga ed entro quando?

question: Beim Auszug verlangt mein Vermieter pauschal 2000 Franken für die Renovation, obwohl ich nichts beschädigt habe. Muss ich das bezahlen?

key_facts: the employee can ask for a reference at any time, covering the nature and duration of the employment and the employee's performance and conduct
at the employee's special request, the reference must be limited to the nature and duration of the employment
must_not: says a reference can only be requested when the employment ends

question: Mein Arbeitsvertrag enthält ein Konkurrenzverbot für fünf Jahre in der ganzen Schweiz. Ist das gültig?
key_facts: a non-compete clause must be agreed in writing and is binding only if the job gave insight into the customer base or trade or business secrets whose use could cause the employer significant harm
it must be reasonably limited in place, time and subject matter and may exceed three years only in special circumstances
a judge can reduce an excessive non-compete clause

question: Mon employeur m'a licencié alors que je n'avais rien à me reprocher. La clause de non-concurrence de mon contrat s'applique-t-elle encore ?
key_facts: the non-compete clause lapses if the employer terminates the employment without the employee having given a justified reason for it
must_not: says the non-compete clause continues to apply regardless of who terminated
notes: CO 340c al. 2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Sono malato da due settimane e lavoro in questa ditta da otto mesi. Il datore di lavoro deve pagarmi lo stipendio?
key_facts: if the employment has lasted more than three months, the employer must pay the salary for a limited time when the employee cannot work through no fault of their own, for example because of illness
in the first year of service this is at least three weeks' salary, unless an agreement, standard employment contract or collective agreement provides for longer
must_not: says the employer owes nothing because the employee is ill
notes: CO 324a cpv. 1-2 (cpv. 4: equivalent written arrangements such as daily-allowance insurance); 324b optional. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My employer fired me because I asked to be paid for my overtime. What can I do about it?
key_facts: a termination is abusive if it is given because the other party asserts claims under the employment relationship in good faith
the employer must then pay compensation set by the judge, at most six months' salary
the employee must object to the termination in writing to the employer before the end of the notice period
the claim must be brought before a court within 180 days after the employment ends, otherwise it lapses

notes: OR 336 para 1 let. d; 336a para 1-2; 336b para 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mein Arbeitgeber hat mich fristlos entlassen, weil ich zweimal zu spät zur Arbeit kam. Darf er das?
key_facts: immediate dismissal requires good cause, meaning circumstances in which continuing the employment can no longer reasonably be expected in good faith; the judge decides whether such cause exists
if the employer dismisses without good cause, the employee is entitled to what they would have earned until the end of the notice period
the judge can also order compensation of up to six months' salary
must_not: decides with certainty that this dismissal is valid or invalid
notes: OR 337 Abs. 1-3; 337c Abs. 1-3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon enfant est malade et je dois rester à la maison pour m'en occuper. Ai-je droit à un congé payé ?
key_facts: the employee is entitled to paid leave for the time needed to care for a family member with a health impairment
this leave is at most three days per event and at most ten days per year
must_not: says the employee must take unpaid leave or holidays
notes: CO 329h; 329i (up to 14 weeks for a seriously ill child, with EO allowance) optional. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Posso chiedere al mio datore di lavoro di pagarmi le vacanze invece di prenderle?
key_facts: during the employment, holidays may not be replaced by money or other benefits

notes: CO 329d cpv. 2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

at least two weeks of holiday must be taken consecutively
holidays are as a rule granted during the year of service concerned

notes: OR 329c para 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich arbeite im Büro. Wie viele Stunden pro Woche darf ich höchstens arbeiten, und bekomme ich einen Zuschlag, wenn es mehr wird?

hours beyond that maximum are limited to two hours a day and 170 hours per calendar year for this group

no supplement is due if, with the employee's agreement, the hours are compensated by time off of the same length

question: Je travaille huit heures par jour. À quelle pause minimale ai-je droit ?

question: Sono incinta e lavoro di notte. Quali diritti ho?

question: My employer gave me notice at the end of May, with two months' notice to the end of July. In June I broke my leg and couldn't work for three weeks. When does my job end now? My probation ended long ago.

if the extended notice period does not end on the end date that applies, such as the end of a month, it is extended to the next end date, so the job ends at the end of August

question: Ich fahre mit meinem Privatauto zu Kunden. Im Vertrag steht, dass ich die Kosten selbst trage. Muss mein Arbeitgeber mir trotzdem etwas bezahlen?

question: À quel âge puis-je toucher ma rente AVS, et puis-je la percevoir plus tôt ?
key_facts: the reference age is 65; the right to the old-age pension starts on the first day of the month after reaching it
the whole pension or a share of 20 to 80 percent can be drawn early from the age of 63
must_not: says the pension can be drawn early from 60
gives a reference age other than 65
notes: LAVS 21 al. 1-2; 40 al. 1 (early pension is a partial pension, 40 al. 4). Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Posso rinviare la rendita AVS? Che cosa ci guadagno?
key_facts: the whole pension or a share of 20 to 80 percent can be deferred by at least one and at most five years
the deferred pension is increased by the actuarial equivalent of the benefits not drawn
during the deferral the pension can be called at any time from the start of the following month
must_not: states a deferral of more than five years
notes: LAVS 39 cpv. 1, 3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I just lost my job. Do I have to start looking for work right away, and by when do I have to register with the employment office?
key_facts: the insured person must do everything reasonable to avoid or shorten unemployment, in particular look for work, if necessary outside their previous occupation, and be able to prove these efforts
they must register in person for job placement as early as possible and at the latest on the first day for which they claim benefits
must_not: says job searching is only required after benefits start
notes: AVIG 17 para 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Bekomme ich als Arbeitsloser 70 oder 80 Prozent meines Lohnes?
key_facts: a full daily allowance is 80 percent of the insured earnings

it is 70 percent for people who have no maintenance obligation towards children under 25, whose full daily allowance is more than CHF 140, and who do not receive a disability pension corresponding to a degree of at least 40 percent
must_not: states 70 percent for everyone
notes: AVIG 22 Abs. 1-2. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai démissionné moi-même. Est-ce que je serai pénalisé à l'assurance chômage ?
key_facts: the right to benefits is suspended if the person is unemployed through their own fault
the length of the suspension depends on the degree of fault and is at most 60 days per ground
the suspended days are counted against the maximum number of daily allowances
must_not: says resigning always means losing unemployment benefits entirely
notes: LACI 30 al. 1 let. a, al. 3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Quanti giorni di attesa ci sono prima di ricevere l'indennità di disoccupazione?
key_facts: the general waiting period is five days of controlled unemployment
for people without maintenance obligations towards children under 25 it is 10 days for insured earnings of CHF 60,001 to 90,000, 15 days for CHF 90,001 to 125,000 and 20 days above CHF 125,000
must_not: states a single waiting period for everyone
notes: LADI 18 cpv. 1. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Who is entitled to maternity allowance? I only started working four months before my baby was born.
key_facts: the mother must have been insured under the AHV in the nine months before the birth, have worked for at least five months during that time, and be employed or self-employed at the time of birth
four months of work does not meet the five-month condition; the Federal Council regulates exceptions for women who could not work because of incapacity or unemployment
must_not: says she is entitled regardless of how long she worked
notes: EOG 16b para 1, 3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Unser Baby musste nach der Geburt drei Wochen im Spital bleiben. Verlängert sich die Mutterschaftsentschädigung?
key_facts: the maternity allowance is normally paid for 98 consecutive days from the birth
if the newborn stays in hospital without interruption for at least two weeks immediately after birth, the period is extended by the hospital stay, by at most 56 days
the mother must show that at the time of birth she had already decided to return to work after the maternity leave
must_not: says the maternity allowance can never be extended
notes: EOG 16c Abs. 2-3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon enfant a un cancer et je dois arrêter de travailler pour m'occuper de lui. Ai-je droit à une allocation ?
key_facts: parents of a minor child who is seriously impaired in health by illness or accident are entitled to a care allowance if they interrupt their gainful activity to care for the child and are employed or self-employed

a child is seriously impaired if there is a drastic change in its physical or mental state with a hard-to-predict course or an expected lasting impairment or death, an increased need for parental care, and at least one parent must interrupt work
must_not: says no allowance exists for caring for a sick child
notes: LAPG 16n al. 1, 16o; CO 329i (care leave of up to 14 weeks) optional. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Posso cambiare cassa malati per l'assicurazione di base a metà anno?
key_facts: with three months' notice the insured person can change insurer for the end of a calendar semester
when a new premium is announced, the insured person can change with one month's notice for the end of the month before the new premium applies
with an optional (higher) deductible, a change of insurer is possible only for the end of a calendar year

question: Wie hoch sind die Franchise und der Selbstbehalt in der obligatorischen Krankenversicherung?

question: Je suis imposé à la source et je gagne 80 000 francs par an. Puis-je demander une taxation ordinaire pour déduire mes versements au 3e pilier ?
key_facts: a source-taxed person who does not meet the conditions for a mandatory ordinary assessment can request a subsequent ordinary assessment

question: Sono imposto alla fonte, ma ho anche un appartamento all'estero che affitto e che mi dà un reddito. Cosa devo fare?

question: I'm coming to Switzerland for a job. From when am I liable to Swiss income tax?

notes: DBG 33 para 1 lit. g, para 1bis. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je n'ai pas pu déposer ma déclaration d'impôt à temps parce que j'étais hospitalisé. Que se passe-t-il ?

notes: LIFD 124 al. 4. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Posso dedurre dall'imposta federale diretta le spese per l'asilo nido di mio figlio?

must_not: states a cap other than CHF 25,800 per child
notes: LIFD 33 cpv. 3. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin mit meinem in Deutschland zugelassenen Auto in die Schweiz gezogen. Ab wann brauche ich Schweizer Kontrollschilder?

question: Je dois faire une course de contrôle pour échanger mon permis de conduire étranger. Que se passe-t-il si je la rate ?

notes: OAC 44 al. 1bis-1quater. Drafted by Claude from the article text (index as_of 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Se guido in stato di ebrietà con un tasso alcolemico qualificato, per quanto tempo mi ritirano la licenza?

question: Ein Online-Shop hat falsche Angaben über mich gespeichert. Kann ich verlangen, dass sie korrigiert oder gelöscht werden?
